review_notes: Read the whole file (one theorem). Within the theorem the mass and gradient branches are parallel, but each is only a few lines, so I did not flag them. I grepped the ESS directory and found the same 4-line `convert continuous_snd.comp parabolicHomeomorph.continuous using 1; funext z; rfl` block re-proved in many sibling files. I then found an existing lemma `continuous_snd_parabolicPoint` in CKN.Foundation.Parabolic, which this file's `open` already brings into scope. I did not compile the replacement. The proof block is small, so the finding is mainly about maintenance and reuse, not a large amount of duplicated reasoning. Whether the lemma's statement matches syntactically is based on reading its signature, `Continuous (fun p : ParabolicPoint => p.2)`.

findings.excerpt:
have htimeCont : Continuous (fun z : ParabolicPoint => z.2) := by
    convert continuous_snd.comp parabolicHomeomorph.continuous using 1
    funext z
    rfl
findings.problem: The proof that the time projection on `ParabolicPoint` is continuous is re-proved here by a convert/funext/rfl block. The same block appears verbatim in at least eight other proofs (BUShortDensityContinuity, BUShortPositivePhase (twice), BUShortCompactCore, BUShortShiftedEarlyIntegrable, BUShortWideGap, BUShortSupportHeight, BUShortWeightedSquareData). The library already has a named lemma `continuous_snd_parabolicPoint` for exactly this statement, and it is used elsewhere (CKN Causality, Integrability, and ESS BUShortUCOpenZero). So the repeated machinery is a known fact that is re-derived, and each copy depends on the unfolding details of `parabolicHomeomorph`.
findings.proposed_change: Delete lines 75–78 and write `have htime : ContinuousOn (fun z : ParabolicPoint => z.2) K := continuous_snd_parabolicPoint.continuousOn`. This fits the file's hypotheses because `CKN.Foundation.Parabolic` is already opened and `continuous_snd_parabolicPoint : Continuous (fun p : ParabolicPoint => p.2)` has the identical statement. No new import is needed, assuming BUShortIntegralSupport transitively imports CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Topology. This is strongly indicated by the other ESS files that use the lemma, but I did not check it for this file. Apply the same replacement in the other listed files, so that no copy of the `convert … funext z; rfl` block remains.
findings.benefit: This removes about 4 lines per use. It also leaves one place that knows how `ParabolicPoint`'s topology relates to `parabolicHomeomorph`, so a later change to that representation touches only the lemma and not about ten proofs. Readers see a named fact in place of a convert/funext/rfl step.
